Action.description: Supported typed gameplay operations. Raw commands require explicit opt-in.

oneOf.description: Assign an integer State field using its declared ownership.
Add an integer to a State field using its declared ownership.
Evaluate the comparison once and execute exactly one ordered body.
Execute the body as each player without changing positional context.
Invoke a named function with a checked execution-context requirement.
Explicit escape hatch; only command-line safety and syntax are checked.

ExecutionContext.description: Minimum executor context required by a function or external call.

oneOf.description: Does not access player self; callable in either context.
Requires a player executor; entry initializes player State.

FieldReference.description: A field reference binds a field identity to its declaring State.

Flow.description:
A state machine bound to one player or global integer State field.

The shared Rust/portable lifecycle runs automatic State maintenance, then
flows, then authored module tick actions. Writes from a module's tick body
therefore affect flow selection on the following cycle. Within a flow,
transitions run before tick hooks, and later hooks observe earlier writes.

hooks.description:
Hooks retain authored order. Tick hooks observe state changes made by
earlier hooks in the same cycle; raw score writes bypass enter/exit hooks.

id.description: Stable identity owning generated private helpers and interval counters.

state.description:
The field's owning scope determines execution: each player or one server
invocation for global State. Lifecycle initializes its declared default.

transitions.description:
At most one transition executes per cycle. Equal-priority guards retain
declaration order; identical guards targeting different states conflict.

FlowHook.description: A named function invoked at a state-machine lifecycle point.

cadence.description:
Tick hooks count matching cycles, including the entering cycle. Counters
reset when a cycle observes another phase. Range: 1 through i32::MAX.
Enter and exit hooks require the default value of one.

function.description: Inherits the flow's player or server execution context.

phase.description: Enter/exit hooks run only on flow-owned transitions.

FlowHookPhase.description: The state-machine lifecycle point that invokes a hook.

oneOf.description: After a flow-owned transition writes this phase.
Before a flow-owned transition leaves this phase.
After transition selection, in authored hook order.

FlowTransition.description: One guarded transition between integer phases.

from.description: Required current phase; arbitrary signed integer encodings are supported.

priority.description: Higher priorities first; ties retain declaration order.

to.description:
Exact destination phase; must differ from the source and satisfy any
bounds on the owning State field.

when.description: No guard means unconditional once the source phase is selected.

Function.description: An explicitly named function with an ordered typed body.

context.description: Executor context required by every caller.

FunctionReference.description: A function reference distinguishes locally checked and external behavior.

oneOf.description: Resolves against this complete program before emission.

id.description: Function identity declared in any module.

oneOf.description: Explicit interoperability; existence and behavior cannot be verified.

context.description: Context required by the external implementation.

Operation.description: A gameplay operation with optional host-provided source provenance.

action.description: Typed operation performed in the current executor context.

origin.description: DSL span or editor node/port metadata; never part of resource identity.

ScoreComparison.description: Inclusive integer comparison bounds for a State score.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound; omission means unbounded above.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound; omission means unbounded below.

score.description: Score to compare, using its declaring State's player or global ownership.

ScoreField.description: An integer State field whose default initializes only an absent value.

bounds.description:
Inclusive bounds applied by score assignment and addition. Initialization
preserves the declared default, matching Rust State lifecycle semantics.
The minimum must not exceed the maximum. Addition uses Minecraft's i32
arithmetic before clamping; these bounds do not prevent overflow.

default.description:
Initial value, applied only when missing. All signed 32-bit values are
supported. Reloading or re-entering a function preserves existing values.

name.description: Field identity within its owning State.

State.description: Revision-one player or global score State with explicit integer defaults and canonical ownership.

revision.description: State schema revision, currently 1; distinct from protocol revision.

scope.description:
`player` stores independent values per player; `global` stores one shared
value per State field and initializes it during load without an executor.

TagMembership.description: A typed membership edge; load/tick tags require server-callable functions.

description: One named owner of declarations and ordered lifecycle contributions.

flows.description: Gameplay state machines owned by this module.

functions.description: Named functions, including declarations unreachable from tags.

id.description: Explicit semantic identity, independent of source filename.

load.description: Server-context bodies run at load in authored order.

states.description: Player or global State definitions owned by this module.

tick.description: Server-context bodies run each tick in authored order.
